v_prior_bd_virtual_stop_refuted.v_verdict: REFUTED (both lenses; a third, skeptic lens agrees). The claimed 15.42 reproduces to the digit, but only in the model's J2 interior-angle fold reading: its J2 stops (phi 12.28 / 162.70) let the J1-J3 dyad come within 1.88 / 1.37 deg of its fold (kit metric, the one H1 and every verified row use; 5 deg = phi 20.8 / 146.6), below the user's 5-deg lower bound, with J2 hitting the stretched stop at a rate ratio of 6.35 (H1's worst 3.15). Kept stops under the kit rule: 21.33 static, 35.56 connected. Priced (stops moved to the 5-deg margin): 18.45 frozen exact, connected, near-touch 24.26 (score 93.29), held out 22.27 vs H1 31.39 under the same harness - better than the verified H1 (27.20 same protocol, 24.48 polish) by 6-9 points, but it is a different configuration than the one claimed and is not confirmed here. Mechanism (lens 2): the J2 'hard stop' acts on a virtual angle no dowel at J2 can stop (physical q2 stop law: no cost, gains 1.13), and the specified 0.2 x 3 mm clock spring cannot carry 0.08-0.113 N.m (a 0.3 x 5 mm strip in a 6 mm taller cap: no cost). Next: re-claim with the q2-stop model fix and a near-touch CMA holding the stops >= 5 deg from the J1-J3 fold, then a fresh two-lens verification.
